full_prompt_en: A square, formal oil-painted portrait shows a young man seated before heavy dark red drapery, with a pale lamb resting beside him. The large curtain falls from the upper left and gathers in deep folds behind the head and shoulders, enclosing the scene in warm shadow. On the left, the patterned back of a chair and a lidded bronze-toned vessel emerge from the dark interior. The young man sits near the center with an upright, composed posture. His light curled hair frames a softly lit face with faint rose cheeks, and he looks directly outward with a reserved expression. A light lace neckcloth descends over a dark central waistcoat. The coat and lower garment are deep red brown, with satin-like highlights following the sleeves, lap and long folds. His left hand rests low near a red-covered table or ledge. A small red vessel with a narrow neck stands in front of him, catching a point of light beside the pale hand. His right hand reaches toward the lamb on the lower right, touching or holding near its ear. The animal lies across the dark seat or cloth; its cream face and long ear remain bright, while the body moves into gray shadow. At the right edge, the background turns olive brown and much less detailed than the sitter or the cloth. A focused, warm light from the upper left and front illuminates the face, white neckcloth, hands, polished red fabric and the pale animal. Strong shadows gather within the folds and at the sides of the figure, making the lit textures appear rounded and substantial. Fine blended brushwork models skin and hair, while more visible long strokes trace the reflective cloth. The overall composition uses the curtain and table as a dark red enclosure around the steady figure, with a few pale forms providing an intimate counterpoint to the ceremonial pose.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形正式油画肖像描绘一位年轻男子坐在沉重的深红帷幕前，一只浅色小羊卧在他身旁。大帷幕从左上垂落，在头部和肩后聚成深褶，让场景包裹在暖暗之中。左侧，一把有纹样的椅背和一只带盖的铜色器皿从昏暗室内浮现。年轻男子坐在中央附近，姿态挺直而端正。浅色卷发环绕柔和受光的面孔，脸颊微带玫瑰色；他以克制神情直视画外。浅色蕾丝领饰垂在深色马甲中央。外套和下装为深红褐色，缎面般的亮部顺着袖子、腿部和长褶皱延伸。他的左手低放在盖着红布的桌面或台沿附近。一只细颈红色小器皿立在前方，于浅色手掌旁接住一点光。右手伸向右下方的小羊，触碰或握住它耳朵附近。动物横卧在深色座面或布料上，奶油色脸与长耳保持明亮，身体渐入灰影。右侧边缘的背景转为橄榄褐，比人物和衣料少得多细节。聚焦的暖光从左上和正前方照亮面孔、白色领饰、双手、光泽红衣与浅色动物。强阴影聚在褶皱内部和人物两侧，使受光肌理显得圆润而厚实。细腻融合的笔触塑造皮肤与头发，较长而明显的笔触沿反光布料展开。整体构图以帷幕和桌面在稳重人物周围形成深红围合，少量浅色形体为庄重姿态添入亲近的对照。
style_prompt_en: The image has a classical oil-painted finish with carefully blended flesh-like transitions and heavier, directional strokes across reflective material. Deep wine red, umber and olive brown dominate large areas; restrained cream and rose accents concentrate near the illuminated center. Heavy folded shapes form a dark enclosure, while small pale forms and highlights create a measured focal hierarchy. Warm light enters from one upper side and rounds the exposed planes, leaving broad pockets of shadow in the recesses. Edges are firm around selected lit details but relax into the dark surrounding field. Surfaces distinguish themselves through satin glints, matte shadow and softly modeled lighter passages rather than through equal detail everywhere. The space stays shallow and ceremonial, built from overlap and clothlike depth. The overall effect is stately and intimate, with rich warm darkness supporting a few carefully placed lights.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有古典油画完成面，近似肤质的过渡细腻融合，反光材质上则留有更厚且有方向性的笔触。深酒红、赭褐和橄榄褐占据大面积，克制的奶油白与玫瑰色强调集中在受光中央。沉重折叠形体构成暗色围合，少量浅色形体与高光建立有节制的视觉层级。暖光从一侧上方进入，使暴露平面变得圆润，在凹处留下宽大的阴影。所选受光细节的边缘坚实，进入周围深色域后则松开。表面通过缎面亮点、哑光阴影及柔和塑造的浅色区域区分，而非处处具有同等细节。空间浅而庄重，由交叠与布料般的纵深搭起。整体效果稳重又亲近，浓郁暖暗托起几处精心放置的光。
theme_en: A formal oil-painted portrait of a seated young man with a pale lamb
theme_zh: 一位坐着的年轻男子与浅色小羊的正式油画肖像
name: Francesco Albani
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
